name: HARTA
recent: Hartalega 在 2026 年 9 月 3 日举行第 20 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于 11 月 12 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利按年增长 79.3% 至 3280 万令吉，但按季下跌 53.2%。同期，KWAP 在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 第 20 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 3 日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
2026 年 11 月 12 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利 3280 万令吉，按年增长 79.3%。
KWAP 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
risks: 季度净利按季下跌 53.2%，净利率由 11.6% 降至 5.1%。
新闻标题提及分析员认为平均售价驱动的次季增长难以持续，且手套行业面临持续逆风。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，营收为 6.447 亿令吉，按年增长 19.5%，按季增长 6.4%；净利为 3280 万令吉，按年增长 79.3%，但按季下跌 53.2%。净利率为 5.1%，低于上一季度的 11.6%。

recent_en: Hartalega held its 20th AGM on 3 September 2026, with all resolutions approved. On 12 November, the company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 79.3% year-on-year to RM32.8 million but down 53.2% quarter-on-quarter. Meanwhile, KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between September and November.
notable_en: The 20th AGM was held on 3 September 2026, with all resolutions approved by shareholders.
Quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 were announced on 12 November 2026, with net profit of RM32.8 million, up 79.3% year-on-year.
KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell 53.2% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin dropping from 11.6% to 5.1%.
News headlines noted analysts view the average selling price-driven 2Q boost as difficult to sustain, and the glove sector faces persistent headwinds.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM644.7 million, up 19.5% year-on-year and 6.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM32.8 million, up 79.3% year-on-year but down 53.2% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 5.1%, lower than 11.6% in the previous quarter.
